source.as_of: DAAD scholarship database entry as served on 2026-10-05 (portal currently closed for this programme)
source.raw_extract:
Application deadline Application deadlines are updated at least once a year. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:

[...] Applications for this scholarship programme are possible between 1 June and the stated application deadline. [...] Currently you cannot apply for this programme. Please note the application deadline specified under the Application procedure tab.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Application deadlines are updated at least once a year. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:
source.notes:
In the live served HTML the sentence "You can find the current dates here:" is immediately followed by a closing

- there is no hyperlink and no date value. The only two explicit dates anywhere on the page are post-application work-sample milestones ("you will receive a link to upload your work samples to the DAAD media database by 23 October at the latest ... please upload the work samples to the media database by 4 November CET at the latest"), which are not the application deadline. The page also states the window opens 1 June but never states its closing date. Therefore no application deadline can be recovered. The shard's stored value "September annually" could NOT be confirmed against the live source and was not reused. records.title: University of Chicago International Student Financial Aid (Need-Based and Merit Scholarships for Undergraduates)
records.deadline_display: Institutional Financial Aid Deadlines — Early Action & Early Decision I November 15th*; Early Decision II January 15th*; Regular Decision February 15th* (* If a financial aid deadline falls on a weekend or holiday, the deadline will instead be the next business day.)

source.publisher: The University of Chicago, College Admissions (Office of Financial Aid)
source.as_of: Institutional Financial Aid Deadlines as published on the live Financial Overview page on 2026-10-05; no cycle year attached to the dates
source.raw_extract: Institutional Financial Aid Deadlines Early Action & Early Decision I November 15th* Early Decision II January 15th* Regular Decision February 15th* * If a financial aid deadline falls on a weekend or holiday, the deadline will instead be the next business day. [International Financial Aid page] International students should apply for financial aid at the time they apply to UChicago for admission. International students are eligible for financial aid only if they apply for funding during the admissions process, and will not be eligible for financial aid after receiving their admissions decision or during their four years in the College.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Early Action & Early Decision I November 15th* / Early Decision II January 15th* / Regular Decision February 15th*
source.notes: Classified ANNUAL rather than EXACT: the official page states fixed month-and-day financial aid deadlines that recur every admission cycle, but attaches no year, and the applicable date depends on which admission round the applicant chooses, so no single YYYY-MM-DD can be written without inventing a year. deadline_date is therefore null with precision "recurring" and the multi-date wording preserved verbatim. The record's official_source_url (www.uchicago.edu/admissions/undergraduate/financial-aid/international-students) returns HTTP 404. The live replacement page for this exact award, /financial-support/international-financial-aid/, states that international aid must be requested during the admissions process but gives no dates at all; the dates above come from the sibling official Financial Overview page, which is explicitly headed "Institutional Financial Aid Deadlines" and is therefore on-topic for a financial-aid record rather than a generic admission deadline. Transfer financial aid dates were not used: UChicago states international transfer applicants are not eligible for financial aid.

records.title: Frederick Douglass Bicentennial Scholarship Program (UNCF)
records.deadline_display: The inaugural application opened during the 2018-19 academic year, with annual applications opening each year through the 2038-39 academic year. A link to the online application will be added to the page when the next session opens. All application materials must be received by the deadline.

source.as_of: Programme page as published on the live UNCF site on 2026-10-05; programme runs through academic year 2038-39
source.raw_extract: The inaugural application opened during the 2018-19 academic year, with annual applications opening each year through the 2038-39 academic year. [...] Application Process A link to the online application will be added to the page when the next session opens. All application materials must be received by the deadline. [...] The program, which recognizes and celebrates one of the most transformative figures in our nation's history, will be administered and managed by UNCF for a period of 20 years, through academic year 2038-39.
source.exact_deadline_wording: All application materials must be received by the deadline.
source.notes: The official programme page describes explicitly recurring annual timing and deliberately publishes no calendar date for the next session - the application link is added only when the session opens. Per brief section 6 an ANNUAL value is never converted into a calendar date, so deadline_date is null with precision "recurring". No month, day or window was invented, and none was taken from the shard's stored note. The page's only deadline reference is the generic sentence "All application materials must be received by the deadline", which names no date.
